title: Enhance error logging for internal API calls
body:
Enhance error logging for internal API calls
  - Add exception details to API 500 error responses
  - Wrap socket errors in AirflowException with request context
  - Preserve original exceptions for proper error chaining
Improves error traceability and debugging for API and socket failures.
Closes: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/58065

-            # We need special handling here! The server can't send us the fd number, as the number on the

-            frame, fds = self._read_frame(maxfds=1)
-            resp = self._from_frame(frame)
-            if TYPE_CHECKING:
-                assert isinstance(resp, SentFDs)
-            resp.fds = fds
-            # Since we know this is an expliclt SendFDs, and since this class is generic SendFDs might not
-            # always be in the return type union
-            return resp  # type: ignore[return-value]
-
-        return self._get_response()
+        try:
+            self.socket.sendall(frame_bytes)
+            if isinstance(msg, ResendLoggingFD):
+                if recv_fds is None:
+                    return None
+                # We need special handling here! The server can't send us the fd number, as the number on the
+                # supervisor will be different to in this process, so we have to mutate the message ourselves here.
+                frame, fds = self._read_frame(maxfds=1)
+                resp = self._from_frame(frame)
+                if TYPE_CHECKING:
+                    assert isinstance(resp, SentFDs)
+                resp.fds = fds
+                # Since we know this is an expliclt SendFDs, and since this class is generic SendFDs might not
+                # always be in the return type union
+                return resp  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+            return self._get_response()
+        except AirflowRuntimeError as e:
+            msg_type = getattr(msg, "type", None)
+            raise AirflowException(
+                f"Could not make API request {msg_type if msg_type else ''}. You may check API server logs (see correlation-id)"
+            ) from e
 
     async def asend(self, msg: SendMsgType) -> ReceiveMsgType | None:
         """Send a request to the parent without blocking."""

+    def test_send_with_socket_exception_preserves_original_error(self):
+        """Test that the original socket exception is preserved as cause."""
+        from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+        from airflow.sdk.execution_time.comms import TaskState
+
+        # Create a mock socket instead of a real one
+        mock_socket = Mock()
+        decoder = CommsDecoder(socket=mock_socket, log=None)
+
+        # Configure the mock to raise an exception when sendall is called
+        original_error = AirflowRuntimeError(ErrorResponse(detail={"error": "Internal server error"}))
+        mock_socket.sendall.side_effect = original_error
+
+        msg = TaskState(state=TaskInstanceState.SKIPPED, end_date=None)
+
+        with pytest.raises(AirflowException) as exc_info:
+            decoder.send(msg)
+
+        # Verify the original exception is preserved as cause
+        assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is original_error
+        assert "Could not make API request" in str(exc_info.value)
+        assert "TaskState" in str(exc_info.value)
